title: Alignment Check Deduction Table for Rental Vehicle Coordination Network Courtesy Days
content:
**Deduction table.** In working out network courtesy days on a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental, the alignment days are deducted from the lost calibration days. The alignment days follow the order's alignment checks: an out-of-spec check corrected in the same visit takes 1 day; an out-of-spec check with none corrected takes 2 days; otherwise zero.

## Records read

The alignment checks recorded on the calibration order under ADAS Sensor Calibrations opened for the insurance claim repair order the rental is for: each check's result and whether an out-of-spec result was corrected in the same visit.

## Alignment days by what the checks show

| An out-of-spec check stands | An out-of-spec check was corrected in the same visit | Alignment days |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Yes | None corrected | 2 |
| No out-of-spec check, or no check at all | | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases

- Two alignment checks, one out of spec and corrected in the same visit, one within spec: 1 alignment day.
- One out-of-spec check, not corrected: 2 alignment days.
- Only within-spec checks: no alignment days.
